frozen.uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ عَلَيْكَ بِأَبِي جَهْلِ بْنِ هِشَامٍ وَعُتْبَةَ بْنِ رَبِيْعَةَ وَشَيْبَةَ بْنِ رَبِيْعَةَ وَالْوَلِيْدِ بْنِ عُقْبَةَ وَأُمَيَّةَ بْنِ خَلَفٍ وَعُقْبَةَ بْنِ أَبِيْ مُعَيْطٍ
frozen.indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ عَلَيْكَ بِاَبِيْ جَهْلِ بْنِ هِشَامٍ وَعُتْبَةَ بْنِ رَبِيْعَةَ وَشَيْبَةَ بْنِ رَبِيْعَةَ وَالْوَلِيْدِ بْنِ عُقْبَةَ واُمَيَّةَ بْنِ خَلَفٍ وَعُقْبَةَ بْنِ اَبِيْ مُعَيْطٍ
frozen.clean: اللهم عليك بابي جهل بن هشام وعتبه بن ربيعه وشيبه بن ربيعه والوليد بن عقبه واميه بن خلف وعقبه بن ابي معيط
frozen.transliteration: Allaahumma ‘Alaika bi abi jahl ibn Hisham, wa Utbath ibn Rabi'ah, wa Shaibah ibn Rabi'ah, wal Walid ibn Uqbah, wa Umayyah ibn Khalaf, wa Uqbah ibn abi Mu'ait

source.name: Dua of the prophet (ﷺ) against the enemy
source.content: When they heard his voice, laughter vanished from them and they feared his malediction. Then Prophet (ﷺ) said:
source.translation: O Allah, it is for Thee to deal with Abu Jahl bin Hisham, 'Utba bin Rabi'a, Shaiba bin Rabi'a. Walid bin Uqba, Umayya bin Khalaf, Uqba bin Abu Mu'ait.
source.note: Ibn Mas’ud (RA) said,”By One Who sent Muhammad (ﷺ) with truth, I saw (all) those he had named lying slain on the Day of Badr. Their dead bodies were dragged to be thrown into a pit near the battlefield”. In another narration, “I swear by Allah that I saw them lying slain in the battlefield of Badr. It being a hot day, their complexion had changed (showing signs of decay).”

source.name: Dua of the Prophet (ﷺ) against Suraka Ibn Malik
source.translation: O Allah! Cause him to fall down.
source.note: Narrated by Anas bin Malik (RA): Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) arrived at Medina with Abu Bakr (RA), riding behind him on the same camel. Abu Bakr (RA) was an elderly man known to the people, while Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was a youth that was unknown. Thus, if a man met Abu Bakr (RA), he would say, "O Abu Bakr! Who is this man in front of you?" Abu Bakr (RA) would say, "This man shows me the Way," One would think that Abu Bakr (RA) meant the road, while in fact, Abu Bakr (RA) meant the way of virtue and good. Then Abu Bakr (RA) looked behind and saw a horse-rider pursuing them. He said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! This is a horse-rider pursuing us." The Prophet (ﷺ) looked behind and said - (The dua is mentioned above)

frozen.uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ أَنْجِزْ لِي مَا وَعَدْتَنِي اَللَّهُمَّ آتِ مَا وَعَدْتَنِي اَللَّهُمَّ إِنْ تُهْلِكْ هَذِهِ الْعِصَابَةَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْإِسْلَامِ لَا تُعْبَدُ فِي الْأَرْضِ
frozen.indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ اَنْجِزْ لِيْ مَا وَعَدْتَّنِيْ اَللّٰهُمَّ اٰتِ مَا وَعَدْتَّنِيْ اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنْ تُهْلِكْ هٰذِهِ الْعِصَابَةَ مِنْ اَهْلِ الْاِسْلَامِ لَا تُعْبَدُ فِيْ الْاَرْضِ
frozen.clean: اللهم انجز لي ما وعدتني اللهم ات ما وعدتني اللهم ان تهلك هذه العصابه من اهل الاسلام لا تعبد في الارض
frozen.transliteration: Allaahumma anjiz li ma wa ‘adtani, Allaahumma aati ma wa ‘adtani, Allaahumma in tuhlik hadhi-hil 'ishabata min ahlil Islaami, la tu'badu fil ardi

source.name: Dua of the Prophet (ﷺ) on the day of the battle of Badr
source.translation: O Allah! Fulfill what You promised for me. [O Allah! Bring about what You promised for me] O Allah! If you destroy this band of adherents to Islam, you will not be worshiped upon the earth.
source.note: It has been narrated on the authority of `Umar bin al-Khattab (RA) who said: When it was the day on which the Battle of Badr was fought, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) cast a glance at the infidels, and they were one thousand while his own Companions were three hundred and nineteen. The Prophet (ﷺ) turned (his face) towards the Qibla. Then he stretched his hands and began his supplication to his Lord: (The dua mentioned above)

frozen.uthmani: إِذْ تَسْتَغِيثُونَ رَبَّكُمْ فَاسْتَجَابَ لَكُمْ أَنِّي مُمِدُّكُم بِأَلْفٍ مِّنَ الْمَلَائِكَةِ مُرْدِفِينَ
frozen.indopak: اِذْ تَسْتَغِيْثُوْنَ رَبَّكُمْ فَاسْتَجَابَ لَكُمْ اَنِّيْ مُمِدُّكُمْ بِاَلْفٍ مِّنَ الْمَلَائِكَةِ مُرْدِفِيْنَ
frozen.clean: اذ تستغيثون ربكم فاستجاب لكم اني ممدكم بالف من الملاءكه مردفين

source.name: The supplication of the believers and the help of Allah
source.translation: [Remember] when you asked help of your Lord, and He answered you, "Indeed, I will reinforce you with a thousand from the angels, following one another." (Sura Anfal 8:9)
source.note:
He (Rasulullah ﷺ) continued his supplication to his Lord, stretching his hands, facing the Qibla, until his mantle slipped down from his shoulders. So Abu Bakr (RA) came to him, picked up his mantle and put it on his shoulders. Then he embraced him from behind and said: O Prophet of Allah (ﷺ), this prayer of yours to your Lord will suffice you, and He will fulfill for you what He has promised you. So Allah, the Glorious and Exalted, revealed (the Qur'anic verse): (The ayaat is mentioned above) 

So Allah helped him with angels.

frozen.reference:
[1] Name of the horse carrying the angel (translator)
[2] Muslim: 1763

source.name: Allah's help upon the Mujahideen #1
source.content: Narrated to him by Ibn `Abbas (RA) who said: While on that day a Muslim was chasing a disbeliever who was going ahead of him, he heard over him the swishing of the whip and the voice of the rider saying: Go ahead, Haizum! [1] He glanced at the polytheist who had (now) fallen down on his back. When he looked at him (carefully he found that) there was a scar on his nose and his face was torn as if it had been lashed with a whip, and had turned green with its poison. An Ansari came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and related this (event) to him. He said: You have told the truth. This was the help from the third heaven. The Muslims that day (i.e. the day of the Battle of Badr) killed seventy persons and captured seventy. [2]

frozen.uthmani: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اذْكُرُوا نِعْمَةَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ إِذْ جَاءَتْكُمْ جُنُودٌ فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًا وَجُنُودًا لَّمْ تَرَوْهَا ۚ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرًا ﴿٩﴾ إِذْ جَاءُوكُم مِّن فَوْقِكُمْ وَمِنْ أَسْفَلَ مِنكُمْ وَإِذْ زَاغَتِ الْأَبْصَارُ وَبَلَغَتِ الْقُلُوبُ الْحَنَاجِرَ وَتَظُنُّونَ بِاللَّهِ الظُّنُونَا ﴿١٠﴾ هُنَالِكَ ابْتُلِيَ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ وَزُلْزِلُوا زِلْزَالًا شَدِيدًا ﴿١١﴾
frozen.indopak: يَا اَيُّهَا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوا اذْكُرُوْا نِعْمَةَ اللّٰهِ عَلَيْكُمْ اِذْ جَاءَتْكُمْ جُنُوْدٌ فَاَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيْحًا وَجُنُوْدًا لَّمْ تَرَوْهَا ۚ وَكَانَ اللّٰهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُوْنَ بَصِيْرًا ﴿٩﴾ اِذْ جَاءُوْكُمْ مِّنْ فَوْقِكُمْ وَمِنْ اَسْفَلَ مِنْكُمْ وَاِذْ زَاغَتِ الْاَبْصَارُ وَبَلَغَتِ الْقُلُوْبُ الْحَنَاجِرَ وَتَظُنُّوْنَ بِاللّٰهِ الظُّنُوْنَا ﴿١٠﴾ هُنَالِكَ ابْتُلِيَ الْمُؤْمِنُوْنَ وَزُلْزِلُوْا زِلْزَالًا شَدِيْدًا ﴿١١﴾
frozen.clean: يا ايها الذين امنوا اذكروا نعمه الله عليكم اذ جاءتكم جنود فارسلنا عليهم ريحا وجنودا لم تروها  وكان الله بما تعملون بصيرا ٩ اذ جاءوكم من فوقكم ومن اسفل منكم واذ زاغت الابصار وبلغت القلوب الحناجر وتظنون بالله الظنونا ١٠ هنالك ابتلي المءمنون وزلزلوا زلزالا شديدا ١١

source.name: Allah's help upon the Mujahideen #2
source.translation: (9) O you who have believed, remember the favor of Allah upon you when armies came to [attack] you and We sent upon them a wind and armies [of angels] you did not see. And ever is Allah, of what you do, Seeing. (10) [Remember] when they came at you from above you and from below you, and when eyes shifted [in fear], and hearts reached the throats and you assumed about Allah [various] assumptions. (11) There the believers were tested and shaken with a severe shaking.

frozen.uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ مُنْزِلَ الْكِتَابِ سَرِيعَ الْحِسَابِ اِهْزِمِ الْأَحْزَابَ اَللَّهُمَّ اهْزِمْهُمْ وَزَلْزِلْهُمْ
frozen.indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ مُنْزِلَ الْكِتَابِ سَرِيْعَ الْحِسَابِ اِهْزِمِ الْاَحْزَابَ اَللّٰهُمَّ اهْزِمْهُمْ وَزَلْزِلْهُمْ
frozen.clean: اللهم منزل الكتاب سريع الحساب اهزم الاحزاب اللهم اهزمهم وزلزلهم
frozen.transliteration: Allaahumma munzilal-kitaabi, saree'al-hisaabi, ihzimil-'ahzaaba, Allaahummah zimhum wa zalzilhum.

source.name: Dua of the Prophet (ﷺ) on the day of the battle of Ahzab
source.translation: O Allah, Revealer of the Book, swift in (taking) account, put the tribes to rout. O Lord, defeat them and shake them.
source.note: In the battle of Ahzaab, those who fought with The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), they were five kinds: Polytheists of Makkah, Polytheists of various tribes of Arab, Jews who came from outside the madina, Banu Quraiza and the hypocrites. There were ten thousands disbelievers in the front of trench and with the Prophet (ﷺ), there were three thousands Muslims. The disbelievers surrounded Prophet (ﷺ) for 1 month. There was no fighting between them, but there was an incident where a fighting took place Ali ibn Abi Taalib (RA) with Amar ibn Udd Amiri. Ali (RA) killed him. This was the fourth year after Hijrah. In that battle The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) invoked Allah against them - (The dua is mentioned above)

source.name: Dua of the Prophet (ﷺ) on the day of the battle of Hunain
source.note:
This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Salama ibnul akwa (RA) who said: We fought by the side of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) at Hunain. When we encountered the enemy, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) got down from his mule. picked up a handful of dust from the ground, threw it into their (enemy) faces and said: (the dua is mentioned above)

There was no one among the enemy whose eyes were not filled with the dust from this handful. So, they turned back fleeing. and Allah the Exalted and Glorious defeated them, and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) distributed their booty among the Muslims.

frozen.uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ جَهْدِ الْبَلَاءِ وَدَرَكِ الشَّقَاءِ وَسُوْءِ الْقَضَاءِ وَشَمَاتَةِ الْأَعْدَاءِ
frozen.indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ جَهْدِ الْبَلَاءِ وَدَرَكِ الشَّقَاءِ وَسُوْءِ الْقَضَاءِ وَشَمَاتَةِ الْاَعْدَاءِ
frozen.clean: اللهم اني اعوذ بك من جهد البلاء ودرك الشقاء وسوء القضاء وشماته الاعداء
frozen.transliteration: Allaahumma innee ‘a’oodhu bika min jahdil-balaa’i, wa darakish-shaqaa’i, wa soo’il qadhaa’i, wa shamaatatil-‘a’adaa

source.name: Blessed masnun dua #1
source.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge with Allah from the difficult moment of a calamity and from being overtaken by destruction and from being destined to an evil end, and from the malicious joy of enemies.
